description: This file contains functions and types for interacting with a Matrix directory, including listing peers and groups, resolving room aliases, and fetching room names, primarily for directory search and management.

classes.name: ChannelDirectoryEntry
classes.description: Type representing a directory entry, such as a user or group, with properties like id, name, handle, and kind.

methods.name: normalizeQuery
methods.description: Trims and normalizes the query string, returning an empty string if null or undefined.

methods.name: resolveMatrixDirectoryLimit
methods.description: Determines the limit for directory search results, defaulting to 20 if invalid.

methods.name: createMatrixDirectoryClient
methods.description: Creates an authenticated Matrix HTTP client using resolved auth info.

methods.name: resolveMatrixDirectoryContext
methods.description: Resolves the authentication context and creates a client for directory queries based on the provided parameters.

methods.name: createGroupDirectoryEntry
methods.description: Constructs a directory entry object for a group with given id, name, and optional handle.

methods.name: requestMatrixJson
methods.description: Performs a JSON request (GET or POST) to the Matrix API with a specified timeout.

methods.name: listMatrixDirectoryPeersLive
methods.description: Lists Matrix user peers based on a search query, returning user entries or a specific user if qualified.

methods.name: resolveMatrixRoomAlias
methods.description: Resolves a Matrix room alias to its room ID.

methods.name: fetchMatrixRoomName
methods.description: Fetches the name of a Matrix room given its ID.

methods.name: listMatrixDirectoryGroupsLive
methods.description: Lists Matrix group rooms based on a search query, including joined rooms and alias resolution.
